## Usage

```tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import { IntroducingProduct } from "@/components/remocn/templates/introducing-product";

export const RemotionRoot = () => (
  <Composition
    id="IntroducingProduct"
    component={IntroducingProduct}
    durationInFrames={90}
    fps={30}
    width={1280}
    height={720}
    defaultProps={{ message: "Template placeholder" }}
  />
);
```
